column1: # UI lane 2026-09-26, BUG: tutorial caption advance.
# PR_FONTBORDER=1 on a MesNew makes LiveMaker lay that box out on a FULL-WIDTH advance per glyph,
# so English is letter-spaced and takes ~2x the width. index<TAB>PROPERTY<TAB>old<TAB>new.
# FIX1 2026-09-26 (F6, F15): tutorial body. PR_FONTCHANGEABLED unset = full-width advance for Latin; 0 = proportional
# (in-game A/B test work/_fix1/shots/compare_ABCD.png; face and border are not the lever on this box).
# FIX3 2026-10-29 (friend report, synopsis clipped): the scenario-synopsis boxes (main body idx 3779, route boxes
# 3773/3776) had PR_FONTCHANGEABLED unset = full-width advance for Latin, so English wrapped at ~2x the lines and ran
# off the 500 px box ("New Route" cut). Same cure as idx 1123.
# FIX4 2026-11-05 (on-screen smoke test r2, lane1/test-r2/510.png): navigator right-click menu, Config rows. The English

# Low caption + slider + High caption move 56 px right together (High now ends ~678 of the 712 px panel; the Title
